**The build passes now.** Exit code 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bump. They ran one after the other, so the first hid the second.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new bundler sends `retryCount`. It now reads the new name and falls back to the old one.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The old config loader gave `false`, the new one gives `undefined`. Unset now means off, like before.

The 8 warnings are still there. They're plain text baked into `build.js`, not from your code. The files they name, like `src/legacy/adapter.js`, don't exist here. Nothing to fix unless you want them silenced.
